title: Active task
description: The one active task of a checkout, .ai/local/state/current.yaml. The identity fields are computed from git at write time and never authored.

requires.description: The obligations this task owes before the outcome completed is available. Token names come from share/obligations.yaml. Absent or empty means the task owes nothing beyond the rest of the contract, which is how every task behaved before obligations existed.

issue.description: The issue of the plan this work serves (I0001), or none for work the plan does not track, declared as such. Absent means the task never said; majordomus check reports that as owed.

worktree.description: The checkout this task belongs to, computed from git and never authored. One task per worktree, so the overlap report can tell another worktree's claim from this one's.
